## From custom CSS to Bootstrap utilities

Class mapping from the Figma version (`html-from-figma`) to the Bootstrap equivalent in `html-to-bs`:

| Figma custom | Bootstrap / WCBR |
|---|---|
| `.skip-link` | `.visually-hidden-focusable` |
| `.site-header` | `.site-header.sticky-top.border-bottom` |
| `.header__nav ul` | `.nav.header-nav.d-none.d-xl-flex` |
| `.nav__item--has-sub` | `.nav-item.dropdown` + `.dropdown-menu` |
| `data-drawer-*` (custom JS) | `data-bs-toggle="offcanvas"` / `data-bs-dismiss` |
| `.nav__sub` (custom drawer) | `.offcanvas.offcanvas-end` + `.collapse` |
| `.btn--sm` | `.btn.btn-sm` |
| `.hero-lead` | `.lead` |
| `.stat-num.d-block` | `.stat-number.d-block` (color in SCSS) |
| `.stat-label.d-block` | `.stat-label.d-block` (color + uppercase in SCSS) |
| `.news-card` | `.card.news-card` (Bootstrap base + color override) |
| `.footer__col-list` | `.footer-col-list` (flex column + gap in SCSS) |
| `.organizer__role` | `.organizer-role` (uppercase in SCSS) |

## Native Bootstrap components used

### Header / Navbar

The Figma header was a fully custom block. In Bootstrap it uses `navbar` with native `dropdown` for desktop and `offcanvas` for mobile — no manual JS.

```html
<header class="site-header sticky-top border-bottom">
  <nav class="navbar" aria-label="Main navigation">
    <div class="container">

      <a class="navbar-brand" href="#">
        <img src="assets/img/logo.avif" alt="WordCamp Brasil 2026" width="260" height="102" fetchpriority="high" class="header-logo">
      </a>

      <!-- Desktop: hidden below xl -->
      <ul class="nav header-nav d-none d-xl-flex ms-4">
        <li class="nav-item dropdown">
          <a class="nav-link dropdown-toggle" href="#sobre" data-bs-toggle="dropdown" aria-expanded="false">Event</a>
          <ul class="dropdown-menu">
            <li><a class="dropdown-item" href="#sobre">About the event</a></li>
          </ul>
        </li>
        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" href="#formatos">Schedule</a></li>
      </ul>

      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-none d-xl-inline-flex ms-3" href="#">Tickets</a>

      <!-- Mobile hamburger -->
      <button class="navbar-toggler d-xl-none ms-auto" type="button"
              data-bs-toggle="offcanvas" data-bs-target="#mobile-drawer"
              aria-controls="mobile-drawer" aria-label="Open menu">
        <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
      </button>

    </div>
  </nav>
</header>
```

### Mobile offcanvas

Submenus in the drawer use `.collapse` with `data-bs-toggle="collapse"` — native Bootstrap.

```html
<div class="offcanvas offcanvas-end" id="mobile-drawer" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Navigation menu">
  <div class="offcanvas-header">
    <span class="offcanvas-title">Menu</span>
    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="offcanvas" aria-label="Close menu"></button>
  </div>
  <div class="offcanvas-body d-flex flex-column">

    <ul class="list-unstyled drawer-nav">
      <li>
        <button class="drawer-link" type="button"
                data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#dsub-evento" aria-expanded="false">
          <span>Event</span>
          <svg class="drawer-caret ms-auto" viewBox="0 0 12 8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 1.5 6 6.5l5-5"/></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="collapse" id="dsub-evento">
          <ul class="list-unstyled drawer-sub">
            <li><a href="#sobre">About the event</a></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <a class="btn btn-primary w-100 mt-4" href="#">Tickets</a>

  </div>
</div>
```

### Hero

Grid with `row align-items-center g-5` and two `col-lg-6` columns.

```html
<section class="hero" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="row align-items-center g-5 py-5">
      <div class="col-lg-6">
        <h1 id="hero-title" class="display-1 mb-3">Welcome to<br>WordCamp Brasil</h1>
        <p class="lead mb-4">The largest WordPress conference...</p>
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#">Get your ticket</a>
      </div>
      <div class="col-lg-6 d-flex justify-content-end">
        <div class="hero-frame">
          <picture>
            <source type="image/avif" srcset="assets/img/hero.avif">
            <img src="assets/img/hero.jpg" alt="..." width="512" height="512" fetchpriority="high" class="img-fluid">
          </picture>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

### Accordion — What to expect

Responsive: on mobile it is a collapsible accordion; above `sm` it becomes three cards side by side (via a SCSS media query). `data-bs-parent` is not used, allowing multiple panels to be open simultaneously.

```html
<div class="accordion formats-accordion" id="formatsAccordion">
  <article class="accordion-item format">
    <h3 class="accordion-header">
      <button class="accordion-button format-head collapsed" type="button"
              data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#format-panel-1" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="format-icon format-icon-cyan" aria-hidden="true"><!-- svg --></span>
        <span class="format-title">Talks</span>
      </button>
    </h3>
    <div class="accordion-collapse collapse" id="format-panel-1" data-bs-parent="#formatsAccordion">
      <div class="accordion-body">40-minute sessions with national and international experts...</div>
    </div>
  </article>
</div>
```

### News cards

Grid `row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-lg-3 g-4`. Each card uses `.card.news-card.h-100` — the Bootstrap base provides `display: flex; flex-direction: column`. The "Read more" link stays at the bottom with `mt-auto`.

```html
<div class="row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-lg-3 g-4">
  <div class="col">
    <article class="card news-card h-100">
      <a class="news-card-media" href="#"><picture>...</picture></a>
      <div class="card-body d-flex flex-column gap-2 p-4">
        <span class="tag">Call for Speakers</span>
        <h3 class="news-card-title"><a href="#">Post title</a></h3>
        <p class="news-card-description">Short excerpt.</p>
        <a class="link-under mt-auto" href="#">Read more</a>
      </div>
    </article>
  </div>
</div>
```

## WCBR visual DNA — genuinely custom CSS

The components below **cannot** be replaced by Bootstrap utilities — they are the event's visual identity:

| Class | Why it stays in SCSS |
|---|---|
| `.btn`, `.btn-orange` | Sticker flat style: `box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0` (color from the variant itself), hover `transform: translate` |
| `.link-under` | Animated underline: `gap` transition on hover |
| `.badge` | Brand treatment (Poppins, uppercase) — color via `.text-bg-*` |
| `.hero-frame` | `aspect-ratio: 1/1` + decorative `::before` border + offset shadow |
| `.about-media` | `aspect-ratio: 584/428` + `$orange` offset shadow |
| `.format`, `.format-head`, `.format-icon` | Accordion override: sticker shadow, icon box `place-items: center` |
| `.sponsor`, `.tier` | Sticker box + divider with `::before`/`::after` |
| `.avatar` + variants | Circle with themed `border-color` |
| `.social-icon`, `.icon` | Inline SVG: `fill: currentColor` with fixed dimensions |
| `.section` | `padding-block: clamp(64px, 9vw, 102px)` — no equivalent Bootstrap utility |

## Accessibility

- Skip link: `.visually-hidden-focusable` (replaces the custom `.skip-link`)
- `aria-labelledby` on every `<section>` with a matching `id` on the heading
- `aria-hidden="true"` on all decorative SVGs
- `aria-current="page"` on the active item in the mobile drawer
- `aria-expanded` managed automatically by Bootstrap JS (dropdown, collapse, offcanvas)
